Cookie Options

When you visit our website, we may store cookies or similar technologies in your browser to collect information about your interaction with the site. This may include details about your device, preferences, or browsing behavior. Some of this information is used to ensure the site functions properly, while other uses support performance, analytics, or marketing. You can manage your preferences for non-essential technologies using the options below. Choosing to disable certain cookies may affect the functionality or personalization of your experience. Please note that you cannot disable first-party cookies that are strictly necessary for the site to operate. These are used to perform functions like displaying this banner, storing your privacy choices, maintaining secure sessions, and supporting basic navigation and login flows.
More information

Manage Consent Preferences

Strictly Necessary Cookies

Always Active

These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.

Performance Cookies

These cookies collect information about how visitors use our website, such as which pages are visited most often or whether users encounter error messages. The data is used to understand and improve site performance, enhance user experience, and optimize content delivery. Disabling these cookies may limit our ability to measure site performance and make improvements, but it will not affect your experience with core site functionality.

Social Media & Targeting Cookies

We provide this setting to allow users to control certain technologies that may be used for advertising, analytics, or related purposes. These tools may involve the collection of technical information such as IP address, browser type, or referral data, and may be used to deliver more relevant content or measure engagement. You can choose to disable these technologies by using the toggle above. When disabled, these tools will not be activated during your visit.

  • Social Media Cookies
    label

    These cookies are set by a range of social media services that we have added to the site to enable you to share our content with your friends and networks. They are capable of tracking your browser across other sites and building up a profile of your interests. This may impact the content and messages you see on other websites you visit. If you do not allow these cookies you may not be able to use or see these sharing tools.

  • Targeting Cookies
    label

    These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.
